title: Gym Rat Raising
description: Raise a skinny 48 kg kid into a gym legend in 90 days. Pick workouts, eat enough protein, work shifts to pay rent and gym fees, dodge injuries and handle random gym events. Watch the body grow muscle (or pizza fat), then face the Gym Showdown: your bench + squat + deadlift total goes on the ranked leaderboard. A cozy idle-raising sim, free, no download, works on phone.
